working_well: County budget absorption rate: 90% in FY 2024/25, 100th percentile within the peer-group (tier 3) — higher than the peer_group median of 82.5%.
Development budget absorption rate: 74% in FY 2024/25, 92nd percentile within the peer-group (tier 3) — higher than the peer_group median of 69%.
Labour-force participation rate, age 15–64: 74.7% in 2019 census, 83rd percentile within the peer-group (tier 3) — higher than the peer_group median of 73.05%.
what_changed: County budget absorption rate worsened by 0.26 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 90.26%, now 90%).
Development budget absorption rate worsened by 16.3 percentage points as of FY 2024/25 (was 90.3%, now 74%).
